notes: A tidier home page. The tiles are now grouped by what they're for instead of what they are: Family (chores, calendars, shopping, recipes, activity), House (Files, House Wiki, Maintenance, Departures), Manage (the admin and setup screens) and Tools (EVE, Ammo, Google, Blue Iris, Home Assistant, UniFi). The System Health and Server cards are folded into one compact Server card - service dots on top, CPU / memory / disk / uptime below - with a Stack Health link for the full detail.
